title: The Wholesale Foundation
summary: Our journey began when Shri Jai Hanuman Bamalwa started a jewellery wholesale business in a small town near Bikaner. What began as a modest enterprise grew through experience, integrity, and fair dealing across the regional trade.
quote: Integrity is the only metal that never tarnishes.

title: Transition to Jaipur
summary: Recognising Jaipur as the historic heart of global gemstone cutting and royal Kundan-Meenakari craftsmanship, the family relocated to the Pink City to deepen artisan networks and source the finest uncut polki diamonds and Zambian emeralds.
quote: Jaipur brought us closer to royal craftsmanship and centuries of artisan mastery.

title: First Retail Showroom
summary: We opened our flagship retail showroom in Jaipur to bring our heritage jewellery directly to families. We eliminated opaque middleman markups, establishing our signature philosophy: fine jewellery at fair value with total transparency.
quote: Jewellery should be beautiful, its pricing should be fair, and customers should feel confident.

title: Carrying the Legacy Forward
summary: Veer Bamalwa represents the next chapter of Jai Sri Ram Jewellers. Building on his father's bedrock of trust, his vision transforms a respected heritage business into a modern luxury house built around transparent pricing formulas, BIS HUID hallmarking, and lifelong customer care.
quote: We preserve the strengths of a traditional family business while meeting the expectations of a new generation of jewellery buyers.
